data.title: 矢来美羽 · 自动贩卖机旁的来客
data.description: 小猫缩在自动贩卖机旁。美羽蹲下来，伸手把它面前翻倒的小纸盒扶正。
data.action: crouching and setting a small box upright near a cat
data.promptProse: Crouching beside a brightly lit beverage vending machine in a quiet residential alleyway at night, Miu extends a gentle hand toward a stray black cat seeking shelter under the machine. The warm, colorful glow of the vending machine bottles illuminates the rain-damped pavement, utility poles, and her endearing, tender smile.
